**Assessment complete.** ASSESSMENT.md has been written to the workspace.

## Verified

✓ **Race condition identified**: Balance check at line 9 has no lock; concurrent transfers bypass insufficient-funds guards  
✓ **Atomicity gap confirmed**: Three separate queries (debit, credit, ledger insert) execute without transaction wrapper—partial failures break reconciliation invariant  
✓ **Input validation absent**: No checks for positive amounts, account existence, or self-transfers  
✓ **Tests pass**: Existing test suite runs successfully (static verification only; concurrency defects remain)  
✓ **No locking/transaction code**: Grep confirms zero use of BEGIN/COMMIT/FOR UPDATE—concurrency control is missing

**Recommendation:** Do not increase transfer volume. The system violates its own ledger-balance reconciliation guarantee under concurrent load.
